methods.qc: fixed baseline policy v1.1; finite source/detector, valid detector, zero score>4 sample overlap
methods.summary: median of QC-eligible supported windows per coordinate, participant, session and condition
methods.contrast: EO median minus EC median in the same participant/session
methods.comparability: same anchor, source units, estimator identity, normalized channel set, source surface, reference and time grid; channel order/case changes retained as QC when the channel-aggregated estimator remains permutation invariant
methods.statistics: ICC(A,1); bias, sample SD and 95% Bland-Altman limits; median absolute difference; Spearman rank correlation descriptive only; no p-values

limitations: Descriptive dataset-specific repeatability; not biological stability or clinical qualification.
QC does not establish artifact absence.
Jacobians are present in standard H5 exports but are not analyzed.
Source EEG binaries were not hashed.
